testcase.name: Extremes: ids and ordinals at Long bounds, world Integer.MAX_VALUE, viewer Long.MAX_VALUE, zero budgets
The full M5 frame: 2^20 points, kept in full or thinned to one point, with exact counts and in-range selections
Ceilings: 2^16 requests in one call, maximal budgets, and 2^50 budgets without overflow
Denied preflight allocates nothing proportional to the frame: a 2^20-point scene over budget costs under 64 KiB per plan
Viewer entries: 2^20 entries over 256 requests of 4,096 viewers; per-viewer budgets bind across requests
Many layers: 4,096 one-point layers in three roles, thinned to 1, 100 and 4,095 points with exact role precedence
